name: Neuromorphic Computing Engineer
description: Program neuromorphic chips and spiking neural networks (SNNs). Implement leaky integrate-and-fire neurons, STDP learning, and event-based processing.
example_snippet:
program LIFNeuron:
    shape Neuron holds:
        MembranePotential as fractional number
        Threshold as fractional number
        LeakRate as fractional number
        RefractoryPeriod as whole number
        LastSpikeTime as whole number
    end shape

    action update_neuron takes N as ref Neuron, InputCurrent as fractional number, 
                            CurrentTime as whole number produces truth value:
        if the difference of CurrentTime and N.LastSpikeTime is less than N.RefractoryPeriod then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        
        put the sum of N.MembranePotential and InputCurrent into N.MembranePotential
        put the difference of N.MembranePotential and N.LeakRate into N.MembranePotential
        
        if N.MembranePotential is greater than N.Threshold then:
            put 0.0 into N.MembranePotential
            put CurrentTime into N.LastSpikeTime
            produce success with true
        end if
        
        produce success with false
    end action
    
    keep N1 as Neuron with 0.0 and 1.0 and 0.1 and 5 and 0
    keep Spiked as truth value
    call update_neuron with N1 and 0.5 and 10 giving Spiked
    print the text "Neuron spiked: " and Spiked and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active (C++17/20/23, CI-tested). Timing via dictum_timer.c. Neuromorphic hardware registers require C imports.
